title: uranium ore
description: This mod adds a new tools and armor tier
body:
☢️ Uranium Ore ☢️

Uranium Ore adds a brand-new late-game ore to Minecraft that goes beyond Netherite while staying fully vanilla-friendly.

This mod introduces Uranium, a powerful new material that can be mined, crafted, and used entirely in survival mode, with full creative support as well. No machines, no generators, no tech trees — just pure Minecraft progression.

If you’ve ever wanted a new endgame tier without turning your world into a factory, this mod is for you.

🔥 Features

⛏️ New Uranium Ore that naturally generates in the world

🛡️ New armor set stronger than Netherite

⚔️ New tool tier better than Netherite tools

🌍 Fully survival compatible — no cheats required

🎮 Creative mode support

❌ Not a tech mod (no power, no machines, no automation)

⚠️ Notes

Designed to feel balanced and natural within vanilla gameplay

Perfect for players who want more progression after Netherite
